profile_paragraph.formatted_text: Diploma-qualified Community Services professional with direct client-facing experience in case management and employment support across refugee, asylum seeker, and CALD communities at Sisterworks Dandenong. Developed and implemented individual case plans by assessing client goals, barriers, and strengths; maintained accurate records using CRM platforms and Excel while ensuring compliance with privacy standards. Skilled in building trust through trauma-informed, culturally sensitive approaches; conducted VEVO checks to verify work rights. Strong communication and de-escalation capabilities proven across diverse customer service and education settings, managing high-volume interactions and navigating complex stakeholder relationships with patience and professionalism.
strengths_highlighted: Detail-oriented, organized, and can juggle time like a pro
Comfortable chatting with business owners and have strong communication skills
Great at solving problems and navigating challenges
